notes.title: Update under construction!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we're super excited to be coming on today and sharing with you all the new content planned for Version 0.8.1! 

This Update will launch on Tuesday the 28th at 12:00 AM EST and contain 2 new Gamemodes, 1 new Map, a new AI Type, and 2 new Weapons! and a ton of balance changes! 

  

--Gamemodes-- 
KOTH! King of the Hill is our first new mode, players must stand on an objective marker to earn points for their team, the more teammates on the objective the more points earned! But watch out, the objective can move around and change locations! 

SND! Search and Destroy is our second new mode, 2 teams face off in a critical situation for the survivor population of PEPs vast world as the Military Team attempts to plant and detonate a bomb in specific locations, the Survivors goal is to kill all the military or defuse the bomb to save their home! 

--Maps-- 
Train Yard! Train Yard is our new map, set in an industrial Train Yard designed with plenty of height vantage points and small amounts of cover making it a medium range snipers dream! but watch out for all of the zombies workers. 

--AI-- 
Alligators! Alligators have infested the Plantation Bayou, be on the lookout for these slow-moving hard-hitting creatures while playing on the Plantation map in horde mode! 

--Weapons-- 
MPX! The MPX is a new 9MM SMG with a high firerate and moderate damage found in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

Crowbar! The Crowbar is our new melee weapon, with a moderate swing speed and a two-hit kill, look for these in loadout drops, Item Caches, and the Mystery Wagon. 

--General-- 
We also have a vast amount of balance and performance changes coming that we will share more with once the update is live!

notes.title: PEP release date!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! after tonight successful stream and a lot of consideration with the team, we have decided to announce the official release date for PEP!

PEP will be available to everyone and F2P Starting 12/14/22! You and 7 of your friends can team up and fight horde of zombies or join public matches and fight other players on a variety of maps and in a variety of gamemodes! 
For anyone looking to get access to PEP early you can still head over the the Patreon and grab the Supporter Tier! This tier will grant you access to the PEP Beta right now!* 

As always PEP will be F2P and include cosmetic only micro-transactions, no new content such as maps, gamemodes, or weapons will be locked behind paywalls.

We Look forward to fighting along side or against all of you in game!



*Steam Beta Access will be given upon verification through discord, this can take up to 24 hours.
